title: Objection to Referee Recommended Order (FOC 68)
what_it_is: The document that obtains a judicial hearing on a referee's recommendation. It must be specific - naming the exact findings or applications of law objected to - and it must be filed with a notice of hearing, not by itself (MCR 3.215(E)(4)-(5)). The current SCAO form is FOC 68 (notice language on FOC 60); do not recreate it, use the current official version.
who_reads_it: The judge who will hold the judicial hearing.
The other party or their counsel, who must be served per MCR 2.119(C).
The court clerk, who must receive it within 21 days of service of the recommendation.
sequence: Identify each specific finding or application of law you dispute, using the finding-by-finding worksheet.
Draft the written objection naming those findings specifically (MCR 3.215(E)(4)).
Draft and attach a notice of hearing - required, not optional.
File with the court clerk within 21 days after the recommendation is served (MCR 3.215(E)(4)).
Serve the opposing party or counsel per MCR 2.119(C) (MCR 3.215(E)(5)), and file proof of service.
If you intend to use the referee-hearing record, serve the required 7-day notice separately (MCR 3.215(D)(4)(c)).
prepare: The finding-by-finding worksheet: finding, why it is wrong (fact or law), record cite.
Confirm the current FOC 68/FOC 60 revision on courts.michigan.gov - PROVISIONAL, unconfirmed as of this pack's authoring.
Confirm whether Genesee requires a concurrence certificate and proposed order on an objection - PROVISIONAL, ask the clerk.

applicable_rules.summary: The objection must include a clear and concise statement of the specific findings or application of law objected to, filed with a notice of hearing within 21 days after service.
The objection and notice of hearing must be served on the opposing party or counsel per MCR 2.119(C).
A frivolous or delay-motivated objection can draw costs and attorney fees.

deadlines.label: Objection to a proposed recommended order's accuracy/completeness
Notice of intent to use the referee record

traps.trap: Writing "I object to the entire recommendation."
traps.safe_move: Not specific enough - MCR 3.215(E)(4) requires naming the specific finding or legal application. Unobjected findings can become conclusive.

traps.trap: Filing the objection without a notice of hearing.
traps.safe_move: The rule requires both in the same filing (MCR 3.215(E)(4)).

traps.trap: Counting 21 days from the wrong trigger.
traps.safe_move: Served (MCR 3.215(E)(4)) vs. made available (MCL 552.507(4)) vs. a Genesee packet's 'mailed' language can produce different dates - count from the earliest possible date, per M16 S16.3.

traps.trap: Objecting because you are unhappy rather than because a specific finding is wrong.
traps.safe_move: Risks MCR 3.215(F)(3) costs. Get advice before filing if you cannot state the specific finding in one sentence.

do_not: Never characterize the other parent with a clinical label as a pleaded claim (narcissist, alienator, PAS, coercive control) - GUARDRAILS.md S2.
Never use the child as a witness, messenger, interviewee, or source, and never record the child - GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute.
Never assert that any recording you made is lawful - Michigan law is unsettled and the exposure is criminal.
Never sign or stipulate to anything on the spot without reading it fully first.

openers: Good morning/afternoon, Your Honor. My name is [Party], and I am representing myself.
I am here to address [narrow issue]. I have [N] exhibits and a short chronology.
closers: I don't have that information, but I can provide records if needed.
I'd like the record to reflect [narrow, factual point] and I reserve my right to address anything broader in the appropriate forum.

safety_gates: immediate danger -> 911, do not proceed on this guide alone
PPO/DV/CPS contact live -> stop, safety resources, do not proceed on this guide alone
UCCJEA/interstate fact -> stop, MC 416 affidavit guidance
recording question in any form -> unsettled law, criminal exposure, attorney question only
child asked/expected to speak to anyone about the case -> stop
exit_checklist: Every objected finding is named specifically, with a record cite.
A notice of hearing is attached, not filed separately or omitted.
The 7-day referee-record notice is served if you plan to use that record.
